highlights: Rotary (Leslie-style) speaker: slow/fast, brake and motor inertia
Shimmer reverb with an octave grain shifter in the loop
Harmonizer with a new grain mode
body: Firmware for **Teensy 4.1 with PSRAM**. Flash `mmb-fw-0.5.78.hex` with [PJRC Teensy Loader](https://www.pjrc.com/teensy/loader.html), or from the editor (**Teensy → Firmware**). Measured on a Teensy: rotary ~12 % CPU, shimmer ~17 % CPU. Full release notes (NL) on GitHub.
